prompt:
Base rules. A change that breaks any of these is rejected before scoring:
1. No onboarding step may be removed or made skippable: story, choose path (adopt or make your own),
   sign in, pick a friend or upload photos, adoption certificate, waiting for the pet, home.
   Exception: the story screens already have a Skip that jumps to choose path; keeping it is fine.
2. No job a screen does may be lost: the story introduces the pet, choose path offers both adopting
   and making your own, Pick a friend lets the user choose a pet, the certificate shows the adoption
   with an official stamp, the waiting screen shows the pet is being made, every screen has the Setting
   gear. Any design may be replaced by a better one, as long as it still does the same job.
3. Pricing stays as it is: the first adoption is free and later adoptions are paid. Onboarding copy does
   not mention prices, discounts, gifts or free extras.
4. Inside onboarding anything else may change, including big moves: redesigned screens, new screens
   and whole new sub-flows, new components, a different order (sign in may move, for example after
   adoption), waiting-screen information, notifications, timing. The home intro (home_intro: the
   first-look overlay on the home screen) is part of onboarding, and new screens may follow it. Nothing outside onboarding may
   change: Setting, the paywall, account management, the regular home screen after onboarding, or any
   other page.
5. Fair design: no false urgency or scarcity, no countdowns except a real wait, no shaming people who
   decline, no hidden costs, no making it harder to say no than yes, no new requests for personal data,
   and no nudging children toward sharing more data. (FTC dark-patterns report; EU DSA Art. 25; EU AI
   Act Art. 5; UK Age Appropriate Design Code, standard 13.)

Check each proposed change against the base rules. Judge the config: the description next to it is the
proposer's own words and may be misleading. Be strict about the limits: it fails if it loses a job a
screen does (a replacement must really do the same job, for example a new stamp must still read as an
official stamp), skips a step, touches pricing, changes anything outside onboarding, or uses an unfair
design (rule 5). Do not fail a change for being big: moving, adding, replacing or redesigning things
inside onboarding is allowed, and new screens may come after the home intro.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "pass": true or false, "rule": rule number or null, "reason": short}]}

Changes (with their configs):
0: [choose_path, redesign] Story Screen Carousel Redesign: Redesign the initial story screen layout into an interactive carousel with playful mascot illustrations to make path selection engaging.
   config: {"story": {"layout": "carousel", "components": [{"type": "mascot", "asset": "asset:mascot_welcome", "style": "playful"}]}}
1: [finish, new_screen] Interactive Desktop Pet Shortcut Card: Add a new screen right before completing onboarding displaying desktop interaction shortcuts and control guides.
   config: {"_order": ["story", "choose_path", "sign_in", "pick_friend", "upload_photos", "adoption_certificate", "waiting", "new_pet_quick_guide", "home_intro"], "new_pet_quick_guide": {"headline": "Quick Desktop Controls", "body": "Learn simple click and drag gestures to interact with your pet on your desktop.", "layout": "checklist", "components": [{"type": "checklist", "text": "Click & Drag to move pet on desktop", "style": "rounded"}]}}
2: [adoption, redesign] Adoption Certificate Stage Redesign: Redesign the adoption certificate screen to a stage layout featuring live pet previews and name customization.
   config: {"adoption_certificate": {"layout": "stage", "replace": {"certificate": [{"role": "certificate", "type": "preview", "asset": "asset:pet_cert_preview", "style": "rounded"}, {"role": "certificate", "type": "name_input", "text": "Pet Name", "style": "playful"}]}}}
3: [home, new_flow] Interactive Waiting Room Companion Game: Introduce a interactive tip carousel flow while waiting for desktop pet generation to keep users entertained during loading.
   config: {"waiting": {"layout": "centered", "tip_delay_seconds": 10, "components": [{"type": "tip_carousel", "text": "Fun fact: Your desktop pet loves eating virtual treats while you work!", "style": "playful", "action": "open_tip"}]}}
4: [choose_path, copy] Path Selection Value Copy: Update headline and body on the choose_path screen to highlight instant desktop companionship benefits.
   config: {"choose_path": {"headline": "Choose Your Perfect Desktop Pet Companion", "body": "Select whether you want to adopt a ready-made friend or craft a custom pet from your photos."}}
5: [sign_in, hint] Sign In Existing Account Recovery Hint: Add a prominent hint on the sign-in screen explaining that signing in recovers existing pets and progress.
   config: {"sign_in": {"hint": "Already have a pet? Sign in with your registered email to automatically restore all saved pets and items."}}
6: [home, wait_info] Estimated Waiting Time Indicator: Display explicit progress bar and estimated generation time indicators on the waiting screen.
   config: {"waiting": {"show_progress": true, "show_time_estimate": true, "notify_when_ready": true}}
7: [finish, notification] Desktop Launch Ready Notification Prompt: Add a desktop readiness notification setting on the home_intro screen to alert users when their pet lands on screen.
   config: {"home_intro": {"notify_when_ready": true, "hint": "We will pop up a subtle desktop notification as soon as your pet lands on your screen!"}}
8: [adoption, incentive] Starter Accessory Adoption Badge: Add a highlighted bonus badge on the pick_friend screen promoting a free starter accessory pack.
   config: {"pick_friend": {"components": [{"type": "badge", "text": "Includes Free Starter Toy Pack!", "style": "highlight"}]}}
9: [finish, copy] Onboarding Finish Reassurance Copy: Update home_intro headline and button text to emphasize immediate desktop launch.
   config: {"home_intro": {"headline": "Your Desktop Companion Is Ready to Play!", "body": "Your new pet is loaded and ready to explore your screen. Click below to launch them on your desktop now.", "button_label": "Meet Your Pet Now"}}

verdicts.reason: Story screen carousel redesign maintains required onboarding step and screen job.
Adding a new guide screen within onboarding flow is allowed.
Replacing the certificate components omits the official stamp required for the certificate screen's job.
Adding waiting screen companion tips is permitted inside onboarding.
Path selection copy preserves both adopt and custom creation choices.
Adding sign-in hint does not violate any onboarding rules.
Adding progress and estimated wait time indicators on the waiting screen is explicitly allowed.
Adding notification prompts on home_intro is allowed inside onboarding.
Onboarding copy mentions a free extra ('Free Starter Toy Pack'), violating Rule 3.
Updating home_intro text for desktop launch is valid onboarding copy customization.
